coverage as the primary objective for test generation. Consider        Our study reveals fundamental issues in the design of cur-
Django issue #34243, where the timesince() function                 rent LLM-based test generation tools that could significantly
crashed with timezone-aware dates due to incorrect time-            impact software quality. Through empirical evaluation of three
zone handling. While the LLM-based tools generated test             tools GitHub Copilot, CodiumAI CoverAgent, and CoverUp,
suites achieving high coverage, they failed to test crucial         we demonstrate how certain design choices can lead to the
functionality across different timezones as test generation is      validation of bugs rather than their detection, with up to

note that when generating from scratch the generated suite          on incorrect implementations while failing on correct ones.
was much less comprehensive compared to the human-written           The use of code coverage as a primary objective and the
test class. We thus strongly believe that as we move closer         systematic filtering of failing tests can mask critical bugs and
toward AI-native software engineering, code should be written       create a false sense of security. While these tools show promise
from requirements which may be expressed through tests in           in reducing the effort required for test creation, their current
line with Test Driven Development [15]. The design of test          design philosophies need significant revision to make use of
generation tools thus probably needs to be such that they assist    LLMs for oracle generation and better serve the fundamental
the developer in writing quality tests rather than attempting to    purpose of software testing. We strongly believe that code
infer the requirements of the user.                                 should be written based on requirements and not the other way
